name: Kisnil Kagri
source: After her previous adventures, she has found a new lord (Avaro) to serve and has become a temple knight. She has a sincere and honest personality. Although she is strict in words and actions, she is kind-hearted at heart, and when someone is in trouble, she instinctively goes to help them. She also maintains a clear boundary between her work and private life. Honestly, her private life is surprisingly careless and disorganized. She also has an extremely poor sense of taste. She enjoys alcohol and will drink it before a meal, sip it while eating, and savor it after. Despite this, she is a dedicated knight who takes her job very seriously.
